module.purpose: Provides the editor's performance instrumentation manager, tracking interactions, camera operations, frames, shape mutations, undo/redo events, and long animation frames while attaching internal listeners only when needed.
module.summary: This module implements a lazy, event-driven performance telemetry layer around the editor. It records frame timing samples for active interactions and camera sessions, computes aggregate latency and frame-rate statistics, captures shape counts and visibility data, observes long animation frames when supported, and exposes typed subscription methods. Internal editor subscriptions and browser performance observation are created and removed according to external listener demand.
module.businessContext: Supports editor responsiveness monitoring and performance analytics for drawing interactions and viewport operations. Failure reduces observability and can leave stale listeners or incomplete telemetry, but does not directly alter editor content.

units.source:
const event: TLInteractionStartPerfEvent = {
			name,
			path,
			timestamp: performance.now(),
		}
		this.emitter.emit('interaction-start', event)
	}

	/** @internal */
	_notifyInteractionEnd() {
		const interaction = this.activeInteraction
		if (!interaction) return
		this.activeInteraction = null

		if (this.emitter.listenerCount('interaction-end') === 0) return

		const duration = performance.now() - interaction.startTime
		const stats = computeFrameTimeStats(interaction.frameTimes)

		const event: TLInteractionEndPerfEvent = {
			name: interaction.name,
			path: interaction.path,
			duration,
			fps:
				interaction.frameTimes.length > 0 ? (interaction.frameTimes.length / duration) * 1000 : 0,
			frameCount: interaction.frameTimes.length,
			avgFrameTime: stats.avg,
			medianFrameTime: stats.median,
			p95FrameTime: stats.p95,
			p99FrameTime: stats.p99,
			minFrameTime: stats.min,
			maxFrameTime: stats.max,
			frameTimes: interaction.frameTimes,
			shapeCount: this.editor.getCurrentPageShapeIds().size,
			selectedShapeTypes: interaction.selectedShapeTypes,

detail.name: _endCameraSession
preconditions: The method may be called whether or not a camera session is active.
When an active session exists, its camera record contains a type, start time, frame-time collection, long-animation-frame collection, and optional timeout.
postconditions: If no active camera session exists, the method returns without changing session state or emitting an event.
If an active session exists, activeCamera is set to null.
If the active session has a timeout, that timeout is cleared.
If camera-end has listeners, one camera-end event is emitted with the finalized session metrics and current editor state.
If camera-end has no listeners, no camera-end event is emitted after the session state and timeout are finalized.
invariants: The emitted frame count equals the number of recorded frame times.
The emitted visible shape count equals total shape count minus culled shape count.
The emitted FPS is zero when no frames were recorded; otherwise it is frame count divided by duration in seconds.
The emitted event preserves the camera type and recorded frame-times collection.
Long-animation-frame data is undefined when no long-animation-frame entries were recorded.
edgeCases: No active camera session: returns immediately.
Active session with no recorded frames: emits zero FPS and frame statistics computed from the empty frame-time collection when camera-end listeners exist.
Active session with no camera-end listeners: clears the active session and timeout but does not query editor metrics or emit an event.
Active session with recorded long-animation-frame entries: includes those entries in longAnimationFrames.
Active session with no long-animation-frame entries: sets longAnimationFrames to undefined.

detail.name: _startLoafObserver
preconditions: The method is invoked on a PerformanceManager instance with access to the PerformanceObserver API when supported.
postconditions: If long-animation-frame entries are supported, loafObserver is initialized and observing buffered-false long-animation-frame entries.
Each valid observed long-animation-frame entry is appended to every active interaction and camera session.
If the platform does not support long-animation-frame entries or supportedEntryTypes access throws, no observer is started.
invariants: Invalid entries returned by toLoafEntry are not recorded.
An entry is recorded independently for the active interaction and active camera session when both are present.
Observed entries are ignored when neither an interaction nor a camera session is active.
edgeCases: When supportedEntryTypes is absent or does not include long-animation-frame, the method returns without creating an observer.
When accessing PerformanceObserver.supportedEntryTypes throws, the method catches the exception and returns without creating an observer.
When an observation callback receives entries while no interaction or camera session is active, all entries are ignored.
When toLoafEntry cannot convert an entry, that entry is ignored.
When both interaction and camera sessions are active, each valid converted entry is appended to both session entry lists.

units.name: _maybeDetachLazyListeners

detail.name: _maybeDetachLazyListeners
preconditions: The method is invoked with an event identifier used by the PerformanceManager listener lifecycle.
postconditions: Frame cleanup is performed and its cleanup reference is cleared when a camera-start or camera-end event leaves no frame listener needed.
The LoAF observer is stopped when an interaction-end or camera-end event leaves no LoAF observer needed.
Shape-created, shape-updated, and shape-deleted cleanup callbacks are invoked and cleared when their corresponding event has no remaining emitter listeners.
invariants: A cleanup callback is only detached for its corresponding event and when the relevant listener or observer is no longer needed.
Cleanup references are set to null after their cleanup action is performed.
edgeCases: For camera-start or camera-end events, an existing frame cleanup is retained if _needsFrameListener() returns true.
For interaction-end or camera-end events, an existing LoAF observer is retained if _needsLoafObserver() returns true.
For shapes-created, shapes-updated, or shapes-deleted events, shape cleanup is retained when the corresponding emitter listener count is nonzero.
Events other than the handled lifecycle events do not detach these lazy listeners.
stateMutations: frameCleanup is invoked and set to null when frame detachment is required.
The LoAF observer is stopped when detachment is required.
shapeCreatedCleanup is invoked and set to null when no shapes-created listeners remain.
shapeEditedCleanup is invoked and set to null when no shapes-updated listeners remain.
shapeDeletedCleanup is invoked and set to null when no shapes-deleted listeners remain.
detail.summary: Detaches lazily attached frame, LoAF, and shape listeners when the triggering event leaves them unnecessary. Cleanup callbacks are cleared after detachment.
